regions.finding: Four distinct Sc(OTf)3/DCE/30 °C arrows were retained: 2b/benzaldehyde to cis-5a, 2b/nitrone to cis-6a, 2c/nitrone to cis-6b, and 2b/N-methylindole to 7a, with displayed partner equivalents, times, and yields.
ORTEPs of cis-5a, cis-6a, and 7a are characterization of Scheme 2 products and do not create duplicate preparations or verify machine structures.

Four separate radical-scavenger controls were retained with explicit additives and displayed outcomes: 21% NMR 2g with dinitrobenzene, no 2g with benzoquinone, 71% TEMPO-CF3 adduct, and 33% BHT-CF3 adduct, with non-formation of 2g where shown.
The radical/copper mechanism begins here and continues as Scheme 5 on page 6; proposed species are represented once as a mechanism record, not preparations.
